# INFINIA BHARAT NEWS

INFINIA BHARAT NEWS is a Hindi digital news website covering India, world news, politics, Uttar Pradesh, business, technology, sports, entertainment and breaking news.

## Website

- Homepage: https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/
- Latest News: https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/latest
- Categories: https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/category/
- Videos: https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/video
- Reels: https://infiniabharatnews.vercel.app/reels

## Content

The website publishes Hindi news articles, videos, short-form news content and breaking news.

## Crawling

Public news content may be crawled and indexed. Administrative pages and private functionality should not be treated as public content.
